Sphere POP → Twist POP (Operation=Bend, Strength=45) → bent sphere

troubleshooting: Deformation wrong: Check Primary/Secondary Axis settings
No visible effect: Increase Strength value
Twist not smooth: Adjust Rolloff for gradual falloff
Partial deformation: Set Weight Attribute for per-point control
description: Performs non-linear deformations: Twist, Bend, Shear, Taper, Linear Taper, and Squash & Stretch. Uses primary/secondary axes and pivot point. Strength and Rolloff control deformation amount and falloff. Weight attribute allows per-point control.
